command: SELECT json_build_object('ts',extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()),'database_bytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),'wal_disk_bytes',(SELECT sum(size) FROM pg_ls_waldir()),'replication_slots',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_replication_slots),'checkpointer',(SELECT row_to_json(s) FROM pg_stat_checkpointer s),'settings',(SELECT json_object_agg(name,setting) FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('max_wal_size','min_wal_size','checkpoint_timeout','archive_mode','wal_keep_size')));
